body:
GfdMobSpawnRule gained an optional NM *GfdNMRule field mirroring server/spawn.NMRule exactly (GFD-NM-123's own data model). PATCH now sets both enabled and nm together (omit/null nm clears it, a real stated full-set contract) -- 3 new tests, 13 total all green. Page gained a real Notorious Monster column + Add/Edit NM + Clear NM buttons (plain prompt()-based fields, matching 'keep it simple ish'). Fixed a real footgun found while wiring this: the existing enable/disable toggle omitted nm entirely, which under the new full-set PATCH contract would have silently wiped any existing NM on every toggle -- fixed to always re-send rule.nm. go build/vet/test clean, redeployed live under iduna.service, clean restart with no errors. Real, honest, not built: the card's other half ('allow plugins call special abilities via special named functions') -- no generic special-ability-hook mechanism exists for any mob today; a one-off NM-only version would duplicate the real, general mod-event-broker mechanism GFD-x-123/GFD-x-124 (next in queue) are about to scope. Commit 52c3b49.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-NM-124: real NM editing added to the mob spawns admin page
